citation.sourceDocument: SSA, Cost-of-Living Increase and Other Determinations for 2026 (Nov. 3, 2025); 20 CFR §§416.1112, 416.1124, 416.1205
citation.sourceNote: SSA's notice: "The maximum Federal Supplemental Security Income (SSI) monthly payment amounts for 2026 ... will be $994 for an eligible individual; $1,491 for an eligible individual with an eligible spouse", and "The student earned income exclusion ... will be $2,410 per month in 2026, but not more than $9,730 for all of 2026." 20 CFR §416.1124(c)(12): the $20 general exclusion, applied first to unearned income, with any unused part applied to earned income (§416.1112(c)(4)). §416.1112(c): the student exclusion, then "$65 of earned income in a month" and "One-half of remaining earned income in a month". §416.1205: resource limits of $2,000 and $3,000, effective January 1, 1989. Read from the Federal Register and eCFR because ssa.gov refuses this pipeline. Read 2026-10-19.
